thread:
Maya: quick follow-up from the postmortem this morning — listing action items and who owns tests/evals. TL;DR: we need regression coverage for the KV eviction pattern, a promptset for the edge-case failures, a load test job for burst traffic, and a chaos drill for multi-region fallback.
Ben: sounds good. can we break into owners + deadlines?
Maya: yes. proposed owners: Ben -> regression suite packaging, Sara -> promptset curation + evals, Alex -> load test job + chaos drill orchestration. target deadlines in the thread below. please ack or propose changes. :eyes:
Sara: ack. i'll start a doc for promptset and list the failing traces we saw. planning to include at least 20 edge prompts from the incident traces. ETA 2025-04-04.
Ben: ack. i'll create a reproducible regression test harness that runs on PRs and nightly. plan: add a new job under releases-test that runs the KV eviction scenario with longer tails. ETA 2025-03-31. snippet of the test runner config i'll use: ```yaml
job: kv-eviction-regression
schedule: daily
matrix:
  seq_len: [128,512]
  load: [baseline,burst]
```
Alex: i can take the load test + chaos drill. proposal: load tests run in staging every Friday at 00:00 UTC and a monthly chaos drill across eu/us regions. Need an oncall window and playbook. ETA for infra & infra-as-code: 2025-04-07.
Maya: thanks. i'll consolidate into the remediation tracker and create due dates with owners. also want a recurring ticket for "incident pattern watch" to detect KV eviction regressions automatically.
Ben: can we add a quick metric for detection? like 95p latency spike when eviction rate > X. i'll follow up with a detector PR.
Sara: adding promptset items: (1) truncated prefix, (2) misaligned kv fetch, (3) transient mem pressure. i'll label them with severity and add to our evals harness.
DeployBot: new ticket created: INF-6217 "KV-eviction regression suite" assigned to Ben, due 2025-03-31.
Maya: perfect — linking INF-6217, INF-6220 (promptset), INF-6224 (load test & chaos). i'll schedule a 30m sync on 2025-03-28 to review progress.
Alex: +1 for sync. need a short checklist for the chaos drill: rollback plan, canary policy, fallback model variant mapping. i'll draft tomorrow.
Ben: quick Q — do we gate the regression failing tests on releases? i'd prefer they block the release for major regressions, but run in advisory mode for minor ones.
Maya: agreed. we'll add test-level severity and have an automated gating rule: block if severity >= high. ops will do the final say for release blocks.
Sara: FYI i'll add a couple of synthetic samples to the eval harness so we can capture quality regressions as well as perf.
Maya: great. last item: recurring incident patterns — i've added a weekly digest job that surfaces clusters of similar incidents (label: kv-eviction-pattern). owners should triage when a pattern crosses 3 occurrences in 14 days.
Ben: neat. please drop the digest results into #eng-sre and the remediation tickets.
Maya: will do. thanks everyone — appreciate the quick turn. :thumbsup:
Alex: thanks, team.
DeployBot: reminder scheduled: 2025-03-28 15:00 UTC — "Remediation sync: KV eviction followups" (calendar invite sent).
